entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The material on record would go to show that, the petitioner was earlier granted anticipatory bail in the present case by the Court of LXVI Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru in Crl.Misc.No.9573/2022 by order dated 30.09.2022 subject to certain conditions.

entities.text: LXVI Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The condition no.1 in the said order reads as follows:
"The petitioner/accused shall appear before the Investigation Officer on or before 17.10.2022 and thereafter as and when called upon for the purpose of investigation."
3. The petitioner had filed application under Section 439(1)(b) of Cr.P.C., in Crl.Misc.No.9573/2022 for modifying condition no.1.
The same was dismissed by the learned Sessions Judge by order dated 18.11.2022.
Thereafter, the petitioner had filed fresh application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., before the learned Sessions Judge in Crl.Misc.No.12012/2022 which was rejected on 16.12.2022.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner after arguing the matter for some time submits that,
he may be permitted NC: 2023:KHC:46062 to withdraw the petition with liberty to challenge the order dated 18.11.2022 passed by the LXVI Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City in Crl.Misc.No.9573/2022.
5.

entities.text: LXVI Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The submission is placed on record.
The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
